name: Linked sessions
description: Runs of agent teams read as their sessions on one clock: any runs picked or compared side by side, one lane per session with each subagent under the session that spawned it, every tool call a mark coloured by the labels or by any field, filters on every field and on time, and a session's calls beside the lanes with the file they come from.

accepts.means: the line <n>: in a transcript, a call (its tool_use or its tool_result line) or a message shown in its session's transcript; in a run's index, the run

units.means: one run: its sessions, with the view narrowed to it
one session: its lane and its whole transcript

derived.from: the folder a transcript is in
derived.how: runs/<run>/
the session the call is in: its transcript's name without .jsonl, and agent-<id> read as <id>
ISO 8601 or epoch milliseconds read as seconds since the run's first line; a time without an offset is UTC
Agent read as Task
the one value that names the call: a path, a command, a Grep's pattern with its path and mode, a query or a Task's description
its first line, a denial's or an error's prefix and an Exit code line dropped
the number after Exit code

derived.from: a Grep's toolUseResult filenames, else its result's lines
derived.how: the files a Grep matched

derived.from: the tool_use's and the tool_result's timestamps
derived.how: the seconds between them

derived.from: the tool_result's is_error or isError, and its text
derived.how: denied when the result says permission was denied, error when it is flagged, else ok

derived.from: the call's file_path, else a Bash command's text and its result
derived.how: the paths with a folder and an extension
the first file's extension, as test <ext> for a file under tests/ or named test_*

derived.from: the Task call's toolUseResult agentId, else its result's agentId: <id> line, else the prompt a session got
derived.how: the session a Task call spawned
the time and outcome of the next call that ran the same command
prompt for a user's text, result for a session's last text, else text
its name without .jsonl, and agent-<id> read as <id>

derived.from: a Task call's subagent_type, else the run's index
derived.how: the subagent's type, else the name the index gives, else lead or agent-<id>

derived.from: the Task call whose toolUseResult names the subagent's agentId, else whose result says agentId: <id>, else whose prompt it got
derived.how: the session whose call spawned it
the time of the Task call that spawned it, on the run's clock
its time on the run's clock
its time on the run's clock

derived.from: a subagent's last message, else its Task call's result
derived.how: what the subagent returned, the Exit code and agentId lines dropped

derived.from: the Task calls it waited on
derived.how: the spans it waited on its subagents, overlapping spans merged

derived.from: the calls that pass the filters
derived.how: how many calls a session has, and how many ended in an error
its time in UTC
